marta: Quick heads-up — I ran a short bring-up for aeon-13b (int6 vs int8). Putting top-line cost/quality + a proposed rollout. Need product/GTN preference on acceptable signal loss vs unit cost.

sahil: numbers in one line: int8 cheaper quality, int6 cheaper price but slight quality gap. attaching mini scorecard below.

lee: +1 to seeing the scorecard. what about latency tails? important for realtime chat.

marta: summary below (small sample, mixed prompt types):
```
Model      | p50  | p90  | tokens/s | cost/token | QA-score (0-1) | rouge Delta
aeon-13b-int8 | 120ms | 350ms | 95      | $0.0025    | 0.872          | baseline
aeon-13b-int6 | 80ms  | 210ms | 140     | $0.0014    | 0.846          | -0.026
```

eval-bot: smoke results: synth-regressions: rouge -0.026, MRR -0.9% on retrieval QA slice, hallucination rate +0.2% (narrow slice). latency tail improvement ~40%.

ryan: For GTN/apps, rough rule: <1% MRR drop and <0.03 rouge is usually acceptable if cost savings are material. Can you state expected unit-cost savings at scale?

marta: ballpark unit econ: int6 -> ~44% lower per-token cost for generation paths. Example: for our chat workload (avg 150 tokens/gen), savings ~ $0.0165 per response. At 1M responses/day that's ~$16.5k/day.

lee: nice. p90 improvement helps SLAs. But for long-form generation, quality gap bigger?

marta: yes — on long context summarization & math prompts the gap is larger (~0.04-0.06 rouge). proposal: hybrid routing by workload slice. Safety/critical flows -> int8; interactive chat & high-throughput -> int6.

ops-bot: quick check — both quant variants are supported on our dedicated infra; int6 needs different kernel set but deployable.

ryan: Suggested acceptance criteria for GTN pilot?

marta: propose:
- Canary traffic split: int6 10%, int8 90% for 48h; monitor MRR, rouge, hallucination rates, latency p90, error-rate.
- If metrics delta <= pre-agg thresholds (MRR drop <=1%, rouge <=0.03, hallucination +<=0.5%), ramp to 50/50 for 72h.
- Final decision: if unit-cost reduction >30% with metrics within thresholds, recommend default route = int6 with opt-in int8 for safety-sensitive queries.

Example minimal traffic config to test canary:```json
{"route": [{"model":"aeon-13b-int6","weight":0.10},{"model":"aeon-13b-int8","weight":0.90}]}
```

sahil: operational note — enable prefix caching for chat flows on int6 to keep quality closer; also run calibration eval on product prompts (50k examples) before ramping.

ryan: OK — sounds actionable. @marta can you prepare a one-pager with the scorecard + recommended rollout steps for GTN? we'll prioritize engineering canary next week. :thumbsup:

marta: on it, will post the one-pager + eval artifact link by EOD. thanks all.
